title: What is unsafe Wi-Fi?
body:
What is unsafe Wi-Fi?

Unsafe Wi-Fi is a public network that can be a trap:
• In cafes, airports, metro
• Scammers can intercept your data
• Steal passwords
• See what you're doing

It's like if someone was standing behind you and watching what you type!

✅ ALADDIN warns about dangerous networks and protects your data through network protection.
